{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_patients.sum()}")

# Check how many rows per patient
rows_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
print(f"Max rows per patient: {rows_per_patient.max()}")
print(f"Number of patients with >1 row: {rows_per_patient[rows_per_patient > 1].count()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution to confirm re-testing
print(f"Sample sequence range: {df['sample_seq'].min()} to {df['sample_seq'].max()}")"}
